log.msg: Read brief + past work + RefineQueue/RefinedCard/RefineCall. Plan: one small class Server/PromptAudit.mjs reusing RefineQueue.owner_text/find (the owner-prompt filter) and RefineCall.run (one no-tools call), with a v4 brief (task|question|statement|note). Pilot on one finished moderate session.

decision.chose: New small class PromptAudit (one file) that imports RefineQueue's prompt finder and RefineCall's one-call runner
decision.alternative: Add an --audit mode to RefineQueue; rejected because RefineQueue also writes Coverage cards, asks.jsonl and AskIndex filings, and the audit must write only its own audit.jsonl and file nothing
